releaseNotes: Fixed: after renaming or deleting UPI, every new-transaction screen still opened on "UPI". Saving without touching the picker filed the money against a method that no longer existed, so it came off no balance. Screens now start on an account you actually have

Fixed: renaming an account left autopay rules pointing at the old name, so they fired into nothing every month while telling you they had worked. Rules now follow a rename, and an account cannot be deleted while a rule still uses it
Fixed: renaming left the old name in your spreadsheet as well as the new one, so restoring counted that account's opening balance twice
Fixed: a friend settling up in kind - buying the food instead of paying you back - is no longer reported as money the app could not place
Fixed: editing a transaction added a second copy to your spreadsheet instead of changing the first, so restoring could bring back the version from before the edit
Fixed: changing a transaction's date threw away its time, showing 05:30 on everything edited - and, worse, left a day's transactions with no recorded order
History and the spreadsheet are now in date order, newest first, within the day as well as across days
History can now filter by a payment method you have since deleted, which is where stranded transactions hide

Fixed: renaming a category left its budget behind under the old name, so the limit vanished from the Budgets screen while still sitting in your spreadsheet. Budgets now follow a rename, and are removed with the category
Fixed: renaming a category or a friend left autopay rules pointing at the old name. Rules now follow both, and a category cannot be deleted while a rule still spends into it
Fixed: a new autopay rule fired the moment it was saved if its day of the month had already passed - so a rule set up on the 20th for "day 1" charged you straight away instead of starting next month

Fixed: a month your phone spent switched off was skipped outright - rent or an SIP simply never appeared for it. Autopay now catches up the months it missed, up to three, and the notification says how many went in
Fixed: an autopay transaction was dated the day it happened to fire rather than the day it was due, so a payment due on the 31st could land in the next month's report
Installs over the top of 3.6.0 or later
